reviews.text: I'm not sure how I missed reviewing Salon Dog until now.   Chicago's best right here.  We have been going every other month for 5 years. Consistency and quality service every time.  The same staff that are friendly professional and an absolute pleasure.     Thank you Salon dog for taking great care of our fur baby!!!

I like our little guy shaggy but he hates being brushed and he was kinda a mess. Salon dog came to the rescue. He can be a handful but he handled it ok, so super happy with their care and patience with him!
Christina and Team are THE BEST!!
They did a great job with my sweet Mickey & were very friendly at an affordable price. Would highly recommend!
THE BEST DOG GROOMERS IN CHICAGO!!! Our pup has been coming here for 5 years and they always treat her so well!! Please check them out 🙌

Not very great at communicating. Walking in as a new customer, not explained what the process was like I was recommended by a client of theirs. Website is very vague and not clear. I paid over $50 but under $75 for my small dogs service, not exactly sure what she had done but I did ask for a haircut. Her nails still feel jagged. I sent out an email asking what was done and to have things itemized as I was a bit surprised by the total cost at the end. The way I was received was so off putting. There were some things I did like, but the whole miscommunication thing is what’s over powering the entire experience. It’s been over seven days now to give and hear an acceptable response at this point, which is why I’m now leaving this review. Bad communication and UNCLEAR Of service received. Did not receive a run down was not explained, Was also brought out the wrong dog when I clearly explained what my dog looked like. They brought out a medium to large size dog when I literally described the opposite color and size of whatever dog she brought outside. Might I ad that one specific detail I requested on my adored pet was to trim specifically a certain way was also not done. She was cute, but she’s always cute, the haircut did not pizazz me nor was that request met. Just appeared they ran the clippers the same all the way through and left the ears long. My dog btw is 11 pounds.

I take my bichon to salon dog for over 4 years. They do a fantastic job and are well worth the trip from Bridgeport. Riley always come home looking great and the staff are excellent and friendly. Highly recommend Salon Dog!

Came across this place while looking for a place to groom my pup. My dog is super hyper and was afraid he was going to be a bit hard to handle, but these girls took care of him and told me my pup was such a sweetheart. First time here and will definitely be back. They are awesome and affordable. Highly recommend!
The best doggy salon ever she grooms two of my dogs cupcake & Chavo looks amazing on Halloween I love to dye their ears and tail
Absolutely thee best! !!
They are great with your pet they how  to groom your pet they way like I highly recommend you to bring your pet
They always treat us so kindly and leave our pup looking and smelling the best. They do a really good job for a great price :)
I've been using Salon Dog for their Self service dog bath set up! Easy walk-in accepted and they provide everything I need to bathe my dog.
They do a great job. My dog is always happy to go to this place and she comes out happy and jumping.
The team here is always so welcoming and does a great job!
Salon dog is the only groomer I'll trust for my dog. My dog has separation anxiety, and they do such an amazing job with him. Reasonably priced and friendly/caring staff

We are so thankful to have found Salon Dog. They take wonderful care of my pup and are so observant of anything that might be out of the normal. Christina noticed abnormal bruising on my dogs skin which allowed me to seek emergency services for my pup. I learned this she has a life threatening condition which I might not have noticed until it was too late. Luckily, she is getting treatment and hopefully will be ok, but without Salon Dog I would have had no idea.

Aside from that, they always give her a great cut and a cute bandana. She loves going there and we will be customers forever, I wouldn’t take her anywhere else. I highly recommend taking your dogs here for any grooming needs. They also have a cute store and adorable treats to shop too.
The girls that run the salon are awesome and have a very relaxing environment for dogs!  We have a bouvier, which is a breed that is hard to groom. Perfect every time!

They are the best loving and caring groomers I had a little incident this last time we took (Romeo) in a Shih Tzu and they handled it very well so if you need a place that will treat your furry family member as their own this is the place to go I highly recommend thanks guys!
they are so nice treat the pets just if they wr there own I love this place wouldnt trade it for no other place thanks guys great job

The only place I'll take my dogs.  All the groomers do a great job and they are so friendly!!!
Be sure to check out their retail, they have a really good variety of options.
Excellent self-service dog wash set up! Reasonably priced and so much more convenient than a bath at home. The staff are also super friendly and they have a nice selection of projects in the shop.

My bigger dog is really scared of nail trims and strangers so I was nervous to have them groomed by a new place. Both came out really happy and shiny and had no problems at all! The people seem calm here. I only really care about how comfortable my dogs feel, since it's happening to them and not me. This place made everyone very happy! :)
We take our dogs here for grooming and they’re so beautiful every time! The staff here are really sweet.
